table.label: Score A contrast, zone 0+1 minus zone 2

E1.name: Event-onset detection timing
E1.reason: No independent review of the event bracket, no delivery-availability record and no calibrated alarm operating point.

E2.name: False-alert burden per event-free lake-year
E2.reason: No independently verified event-free control lake-years or measured exposure.

E3.name: Out-of-sample seasonal percentile of post-event scores
E3.reason: No rolling-origin models: every checkpoint was fitted on 2018-2021 and early-2023 scenes.

E4.name: Within-scene zone 0+1 versus zone 2 contrast
E4.reason: Zones follow the 2017 Hi-MAG outline, not a 2018-2023 shoreline; patches are dependent.

E5.name: Incremental warning value at a common operating point
E5.reason: No common calibrated operating point and no verified controls.
